Adding an attribute to a visit goes through a POST to the REST module, then through the core service and Hibernate DAO. Editing an existing attribute takes the same server path but uses a different URL.

**Frontend (openmrs-esm-patient-chart)**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/visit-form.resource.ts:172` — `createVisitAttribute` sends `POST ${restBaseUrl}/visit/${visitUuid}/attribute` with `{ attributeType, value }`. This is the function that sends the request for a new attribute.
- `visit-form.resource.ts:180` — `updateVisitAttribute` sends `POST .../visit/${visitUuid}/attribute/${visitAttributeUuid}` with `{ value }` for an attribute that already exists.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/exported-visit-form.workspace.tsx:192` — `handleVisitAttributes` decides, per attribute type, whether to update or create. I read the update branch (lines 199–229). I did not read the `else` branch, so the link from there to `createVisitAttribute` is inferred from the function names rather than checked.

**Server, REST layer (openmrs-module-webservices.rest)**
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/VisitAttributeResource1_9.java:97` — `save`. It attaches the attribute to the visit (`setAttribute` when max occurs is 1, otherwise `addAttribute` if not already present), then calls `Context.getVisitService().saveVisit(delegate.getVisit())` at line 114.

**Core service (openmrs-core)**
- `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/VisitService.java:222` — `saveVisit` interface declaration.
- `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/VisitServiceImpl.java:178` — `saveVisit` checks the ADD_VISITS or EDIT_VISITS privilege, calls `CustomDatatypeUtil.saveAttributesIfNecessary`, then `dao.saveVisit(visit)`.

**Data access (openmrs-core)**
- `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/VisitDAO.java:86` — `saveVisit` DAO interface declaration.
- `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateVisitDAO.java:167` — `saveVisit` calls `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate(getCurrentSession(), visit)`. This is the database write.
